About Me

Hello!

My name is Frederick Adarode and I'm  

I'm a full stack developer and the founder of ADR Systems — a software company building cloud platforms for business, education, hospitality, energy, and smart living. I design, engineer, and ship every product end-to-end.

With several years of expertise across the modern stack — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native, Expo, Angular, and the Ionic Framework — complemented by backend proficiency in Node.js, Express, MySQL, and MongoDB — I turn complex business requirements into clean, working software across web and mobile. My work spans custom client builds, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cross-platform mobile applications, and analytics integrations. Fueled by a growth mindset and a passion for innovation, I thrive on transforming ideas into reliable digital products that businesses actually use every day.
